exampleSentences.en: I arrived earlier than everyone else.
exampleSentences.zh: 我比其他人都早到。

exampleSentences.en: Earlier studies underestimated the long-term environmental impact.
exampleSentences.zh: 早期研究低估了長期環境影響。

earlier.mnemonicHint: early 的 y 變 i 加 er，表示更早。

exampleSentences.en: The town depends on tourists for economic activity.
exampleSentences.zh: 這座城鎮的經濟活動仰賴觀光客。

exampleSentences.en: Economic inequality can limit access to higher education.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟不平等可能限制取得高等教育的機會。

economic.mnemonicHint: economic 關乎 economy 經濟；economical 則是節省的。

exampleSentences.en: The medicine had an immediate effect.
exampleSentences.zh: 這種藥立刻產生效果。

exampleSentences.en: The policy had little effect on overall consumer behavior.
exampleSentences.zh: 該政策對整體消費者行為幾乎沒有影響。

effect.mnemonicHint: effect 多作名詞「結果」；affect 多作動詞「影響」。

exampleSentences.en: Our new chore chart is effecting a welcome change in how we share housework.
exampleSentences.zh: 新的家事分工表正促使我們以更理想的方式分擔家務。

exampleSentences.en: The intervention succeeded in effecting a measurable reduction in school absences.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項介入措施成功促使學生缺席率出現可測量的下降。

effecting.mnemonicHint: effect 作動詞是促成，別和 affecting 影響混淆

exampleSentences.en: Our efforts finally paid off.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的努力終於有了回報。

exampleSentences.en: International efforts have reduced the spread of the disease.
exampleSentences.zh: 國際間的努力已降低疾病傳播。

efforts.mnemonicHint: effort 加 s，表示多次投入力量的嘗試。

exampleSentences.en: Nora gave an eloquent toast that brought tears to the newlyweds' eyes.
exampleSentences.zh: 諾拉致了一段感人的祝酒詞，讓新婚夫妻熱淚盈眶。

exampleSentences.en: The candidate offered an eloquent defense of judicial independence during the oral exam.
exampleSentences.zh: 考生在口試中雄辯地捍衛司法獨立。

eloquent.mnemonicHint: e 加 loquent 說話，善說就是 eloquent

exampleSentences.en: The professor elucidated the complex theory with examples.
exampleSentences.zh: 教授用例子闡明了複雜理論。

exampleSentences.en: The research elucidated how stress affects immunity.
exampleSentences.zh: 研究闡明了壓力影響免疫力的機制。

elucidated.mnemonicHint: e(out) + lucid(clear) + ate → 使清楚 → 闡明

exampleSentences.en: My morning encounters with the neighbor's puppy always brighten my commute.
exampleSentences.zh: 早上遇見鄰居的小狗，總能讓我的通勤心情變好。

exampleSentences.en: The interviews reveal that repeated encounters with discrimination shaped the migrants' identities.
exampleSentences.zh: 訪談顯示，反覆遭遇歧視形塑了移民的身分認同。

encounters.mnemonicHint: en 加 counter 面對，encounter 是碰上

exampleSentences.en: Sharing tools with our neighbors engenders trust across the apartment building.
exampleSentences.zh: 與鄰居共用工具，能在整棟公寓中培養信任。

exampleSentences.en: The author argues that unequal access to education engenders persistent social conflict.
exampleSentences.zh: 作者主張，教育機會不均會引發持續的社會衝突。

engenders.mnemonicHint: gender 與產生相關，engender 是造成

engineered.chinese: 設計製造的；精心策劃的；改造的

exampleSentences.en: The shelf was engineered to support several heavy boxes.
exampleSentences.zh: 這個架子經過設計，能承受好幾個重箱子。

exampleSentences.en: Scientists engineered the bacteria to produce a medically useful protein.
exampleSentences.zh: 科學家改造這種細菌，使其製造具有醫療用途的蛋白質。

engineered.mnemonicHint: engineer 是工程師，也可作動詞表示像工程師一樣精密設計；engineered 是其過去式或形容詞。

enough large.chinese: 錯誤語序：應為 large enough

exampleSentences.en: I asked whether the suitcase was enough large, and my friend corrected me to large enough.
exampleSentences.zh: 我問行李箱是否 enough large，朋友便糾正我應說 large enough。

exampleSentences.en: In the grammar question, enough large must become large enough when enough modifies the adjective.
exampleSentences.zh: 在這道文法題中，當 enough 修飾形容詞時，enough large 必須改成 large enough。

enough large.mnemonicHint: enough 修飾形容詞時放後面：large enough

enough largely.chinese: 不自然語序：應依語意改寫

exampleSentences.en: I typed enough largely by mistake when I meant large enough to describe the room.
exampleSentences.zh: 我想用 large enough 形容房間夠大時，誤打成 enough largely。

exampleSentences.en: The editing exercise flags enough largely because enough does not naturally modify the adverb largely.
exampleSentences.zh: 編輯練習將 enough largely 標為錯誤，因為 enough 通常不能自然地修飾副詞 largely。

enough largely.mnemonicHint: largely 是副詞；先確認要說 largely 還是 large enough

exampleSentences.en: Please lock the window to ensure the room stays dry.
exampleSentences.zh: 請把窗戶鎖好，以確保房間保持乾燥。

exampleSentences.en: Independent audits help ensure that public funds are used for their intended purpose.
exampleSentences.zh: 獨立稽核有助於確保公共資金用於原定目的。

ensure.mnemonicHint: ensure 是讓結果變得 sure，也就是確保；insure 通常指投保。

exampleSentences.en: I spent the entire afternoon cleaning.
exampleSentences.zh: 我花了整個下午打掃。

exampleSentences.en: The policy affected the entire population rather than a single group.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項政策影響全體人口，而非單一群體。

entire.mnemonicHint: entire 與 entirety 同族，表示完整全部。

exampleSentences.en: Our train delay entitles each passenger to a partial refund.
exampleSentences.zh: 火車誤點使每位乘客都有權獲得部分退款。

exampleSentences.en: Successful completion of the course entitles students to receive a professional certificate.
exampleSentences.zh: 完成這門課程後，學生有權取得專業證書。

entitles.mnemonicHint: title 可代表權利，entitle 是賦予資格

exampleSentences.en: The fine mesh entraps food scraps before they clog the kitchen drain.
exampleSentences.zh: 細網會截住食物殘渣，避免它們堵塞廚房排水管。

exampleSentences.en: The porous membrane entraps airborne particles while allowing water vapor to pass.
exampleSentences.zh: 多孔膜會截留空氣中的微粒，同時讓水蒸氣通過。

entraps.mnemonicHint: en 進入加 trap 陷阱，使落入圈套

exampleSentences.en: We joined an environmental cleanup on Saturday.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們星期六參加了環境清潔活動。

exampleSentences.en: Environmental regulation can reduce industrial pollution.
exampleSentences.zh: 環境法規可以減少工業污染。

environmental.mnemonicHint: environment 環境 + al 形容詞字尾。

exampleSentences.en: Evaporation left a white mineral ring around the flowerpot saucer.
exampleSentences.zh: 水分蒸發後，在花盆底盤周圍留下一圈白色礦物質痕跡。

exampleSentences.en: The experiment measured the rate of evaporation under different wind speeds.
exampleSentences.zh: 該實驗測量不同風速下的蒸發速率。

evaporation.mnemonicHint: vapor 蒸氣，evaporation 是變成蒸氣

exampleSentences.en: After two piano lessons, Maya can even play the chorus without looking at the keys.
exampleSentences.zh: 上了兩堂鋼琴課後，瑪雅甚至能不看琴鍵就彈出副歌。

exampleSentences.en: Minor changes in soil moisture may even play a decisive role in seed germination.
exampleSentences.zh: 土壤濕度的微小變化甚至可能在種子發芽中扮演決定性角色。

even play.mnemonicHint: even 加動詞 play，強調連玩或扮演都包括

exampleSentences.en: The wet floor was evidence that it had rained.
exampleSentences.zh: 濕地板是剛下過雨的跡象。

exampleSentences.en: The available evidence does not establish a causal relationship.
exampleSentences.zh: 現有證據無法證實因果關係。

evidence.mnemonicHint: e- 出 + vid 看：能被看出來的就是證據。

exampleSentences.en: Skipping meals can exacerbate headaches and fatigue.
exampleSentences.zh: 不吃飯會加重頭痛和疲勞。

exampleSentences.en: Climate change is expected to exacerbate existing inequalities in developing nations.
exampleSentences.zh: 氣候變遷預計將加劇發展中國家現有的不平等。

exacerbate.mnemonicHint: ex(out) + acerb(bitter) + ate → 使更苦澀 → 使惡化

exampleSentences.en: The hotel offers exclusive access to a private beach.
exampleSentences.zh: 飯店提供專屬的私人海灘。

exampleSentences.en: Exclusive licensing agreements limit market competition.
exampleSentences.zh: 獨家授權協議限制市場競爭。

exclusive.mnemonicHint: ex(out) + clus(close) + ive → 把別人關在外面 → 排他的

exampleSentences.en: Cycling down the coastal road at sunrise was exhilarating.
exampleSentences.zh: 日出時沿著海岸公路騎車，令人興奮不已。

exampleSentences.en: The memoir gives an exhilarating account of the first successful polar flight.
exampleSentences.zh: 這本回憶錄對首次成功的極地飛行做了振奮人心的描述。

exhilarating.mnemonicHint: 像吸入清新 air，exhilarating 令人精神振奮

exampleSentences.en: The writer spent ten years in exile.
exampleSentences.zh: 作家在流放中度過了十年。

exampleSentences.en: Political exile has been a common fate for dissidents.
exampleSentences.zh: 政治流放是異議人士的常見命運。

exile.mnemonicHint: ex(out) + ile → 被趕出去 → 流放

exampleSentences.en: The bakery expanded its menu to include three vegan cakes.
exampleSentences.zh: 這間麵包店擴充了菜單，加入三款純素蛋糕。

exampleSentences.en: As trade expanded, coastal settlements developed into major commercial centers.
exampleSentences.zh: 隨著貿易擴張，沿海聚落發展成重要的商業中心。

expanded.mnemonicHint: expand 是向外擴張，expanded 表示已經擴大；別和花費掉的 expended 混淆。

exampleSentences.en: I expect the repair shop to call before noon.
exampleSentences.zh: 我預期修理店會在中午前打電話來。

exampleSentences.en: Economists expect demand to decline if borrowing costs remain high.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟學家預期，若借貸成本持續偏高，需求將會下降。

expect.mnemonicHint: expect 是預期某事會來；except 是把某事排除在外，兩者只差前綴中的一個字母。

exampleSentences.en: Government expenditure on education has increased.
exampleSentences.zh: 政府在教育上的支出增加了。

exampleSentences.en: Capital expenditure decisions require cost-benefit analysis.
exampleSentences.zh: 資本支出決策需要成本效益分析。

expenditure.mnemonicHint: ex(out) + pend(pay) + iture → 付出去的錢 → 支出

exampleSentences.en: We laughed while sharing our worst travel experiences.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們分享彼此最糟的旅行經歷時笑了出來。

exampleSentences.en: Early childhood experiences can influence how individuals respond to stress later in life.
exampleSentences.zh: 幼兒時期的經歷可能影響個人在日後如何因應壓力。

experiences.mnemonicHint: experiences 是親身經歷的事情；累積這些經歷後，就會形成 experience 經驗。

exampleSentences.en: The museum invited local experts to identify the old coins.
exampleSentences.zh: 博物館邀請當地專家鑑定這些古錢幣。

exampleSentences.en: Public-health experts warned that the small sample could not support a broad conclusion.
exampleSentences.zh: 公共衛生專家警告，這個小型樣本不足以支持廣泛的結論。

experts.mnemonicHint: experts 擁有 expertise 專業知識；novices 則是剛入門的新手。

exampleSentences.en: Can you explain how this button works?
exampleSentences.zh: 你能解釋這個按鈕如何運作嗎？

exampleSentences.en: The model cannot fully explain the observed regional variation.
exampleSentences.zh: 該模型無法充分解釋觀察到的區域差異。

explain.mnemonicHint: ex- 向外 + plain 清楚：把意思說清楚。

exampleSentences.en: Dad expounded his shortcut in such detail that we missed the highway exit.
exampleSentences.zh: 爸爸太過詳細地解說他的捷徑，結果我們錯過了高速公路出口。

exampleSentences.en: The economist expounded the theory of comparative advantage with a numerical example.
exampleSentences.zh: 經濟學家以數值範例詳述比較利益理論。

expounded.mnemonicHint: ex 向外加 pound 放出觀點，詳細說明

exampleSentences.en: Ben opened the empty cake box, expressing surprise with a loud gasp.
exampleSentences.zh: 班打開空的蛋糕盒，大聲倒抽一口氣表示驚訝。

exampleSentences.en: By expressing surprise at the null result, the lecturer revealed an expectation of correlation.
exampleSentences.zh: 講師對無顯著結果表示驚訝，透露他原本預期變數之間會有相關。

expressing surprise.mnemonicHint: express 把 surprise 驚訝說出來

exampleSentences.en: The bank confirmed that the mistaken late fee had been expunged from my record.
exampleSentences.zh: 銀行確認，那筆誤收的滯納金已從我的紀錄中刪除。

exampleSentences.en: All personal identifiers were expunged from the transcripts before qualitative analysis.
exampleSentences.zh: 進行質性分析前，逐字稿中的所有個人識別資訊都已刪除。

expunged.mnemonicHint: ex 出去加 pung 刺，把記錄徹底剔除

exampleSentences.en: The bakery sells exquisite fruit tarts decorated with tiny chocolate leaves.
exampleSentences.zh: 這家麵包店販售精緻的水果塔，上面裝飾著小巧的巧克力葉片。

exampleSentences.en: Microscopy revealed the insect wing's exquisite network of veins.
exampleSentences.zh: 顯微鏡觀察揭示了昆蟲翅膀上精巧的翅脈網絡。

exquisite.mnemonicHint: exquisite 音節精緻，聯想精雕細琢

exampleSentences.en: The burst pipe caused extensive damage to our kitchen floor and cabinets.
exampleSentences.zh: 水管爆裂，造成廚房地板和櫥櫃大範圍損壞。

exampleSentences.en: The conclusion rests on extensive archival research across six national libraries.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項結論建立在六座國家圖書館的大量檔案研究之上。

extensive.mnemonicHint: extend 延伸，extensive 延伸範圍很廣

exampleSentences.en: She has an extraordinary memory for names.
exampleSentences.zh: 她對名字有非凡的記憶力。

exampleSentences.en: The species demonstrates an extraordinary capacity to adapt.
exampleSentences.zh: 該物種展現非凡的適應能力。

extraordinary.mnemonicHint: extra 超出 + ordinary 平常：超乎尋常。

exampleSentences.en: The wedding was criticized for its extravagant decorations.
exampleSentences.zh: 婚禮因其奢侈的裝飾而受到批評。

exampleSentences.en: Extravagant spending during economic downturns draws public criticism.
exampleSentences.zh: 在經濟低迷時期的奢侈支出引發公眾批評。

extravagant.mnemonicHint: extra(beyond) + vag(wander) + ant → 超出常規地花錢 → 奢侈的

glosses.endangered: 有生命危險的；瀕臨滅絕的
glosses.ensures: 確保( ensure的第三人稱單數…
glosses.inclusive: 包容的；涵蓋廣泛的；包括在內的
glosses.large enough: 夠大；尺寸足以符合需求
glosses.obscure: 模糊的；晦澀的；鮮為人知的；遮蔽
